name: Trezukaken
backstory: Child of Trezukar and Tamuzaken; raised in Terfila on settles the house's accounts at the market stalls..., and carries some knowledge of Birth Of Trezukuzco.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Tamuzaken, named Tamuzakar.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Trezukar, named Tamuzakar.

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only by paying real attention to Birth Of Darnakus
criterion.wasted_life: letting Birth Of Darnakus slip past unexamined, the way it's easiest to
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: takes to the transit route himself now when a ship idles too long in port, and finds he still slows near the temple without quite meaning to.

arc.premise: Trezukaken wants a proper shelter built at the midpoint of the transit route, where travelers are stuck in the open when a crossing gets delayed - he's got the materials scavenged, just needs someone to help raise it before the next bad season.
